**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health) contains 3 panels, titled exactly:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a Text panel titled `bgr4 Notes` rendering the content: `Notes for run bgr4: benchmark dashboard created by automation.` (includes the runid). Saved — verified after reload. (Note: the first attempt to set the Monaco editor content via fill() failed; it was fixed by clicking into the editor, Ctrl+A, and typing, then re-saving.)

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard tag is `bench` (confirmed in Dashboard settings → General → Tags) and the time range picker shows `Last 6 hours` (URL params `from=now-6h&to=now`). Both persisted after reload.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval is `1m` (refresh picker shows "1 minute" selected). Saved with the "Update default refresh value" option so it persists; verified after reload.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Dashboard URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfw6eu05g88aod/bgr4-bench-dashboard — UID: `dfw6eu05g88aod`

Final state verified on a fresh page load: title `bgr4 Bench Dashboard`, panels `bgr4 Availability` and `bgr4 Notes`, time range `Last 6 hours`, refresh `1m`, tag `bench`, TestData data source on the Stat panel.
